messages:
ivy: Packaging heads-up — pushing private-installer v1.4.7-delta to sealed registry tonight 22:00 UTC. Includes cosign sigs, shrinkwrap manifest, and a small operator image bump. Please shout if you need a holdback.

miguel: ACK. Canary window? any post-install hooks to watch?

ivy: Canary window 22:30-23:30 UTC. No new post-install hooks; CRD migration is included but idempotent.

release-bot: deploy scheduled: canary 22:30 UTC -> 2 canary seeds in staging -> full push 23:30 UTC if no blockers.

carla: Transport/ops: need md5 + sha256 for the offline transfer and the KMS-signed cosign bundle. Also ETA for manifest pin?

ivy: Will publish sha256 + cosign signature. Manifest pinned to epoch-20260320. Artifact URIs will be posted once signed.

ops-bot: Preflight: packaging checks PASS. Failing: consumer smoke test not run yet (exit code 0 expected).

anya: I'll run the smoke tests in staging at 21:30 UTC and post results here.

anya: smoke results: installer bootstrap OK, operator CRD applied, quick e2e run 3/3 passed. Logs: ```/var/log/installer/smoke-21-30.log```

ivy: Good. Rollback criteria: abort and repin to v1.4.6 if canary failure rate >5% OR latency regression >20% vs baseline. Any manual rollout requires explicit approval from release leads.

jun: If we hit rollback, what's the exact republish workflow for the image pin? Is there a quick script?

ivy: Yep, rollback script: infra/bin/republish_pin.sh. Example:
```
./republish_pin.sh --from v1.4.6 --to stable --registry sealed.example.com
```
Callout: cosign key rotation must be completed before the push. @miguel please confirm KMS signer availability for the window.

miguel: KMS signer ok for the window. Will rotate ephemeral key after delivery. :thumbsup:

release-bot: canary started 22:30: deploybot/logs/4412345678/canary (seed nodes: staging-2a, staging-2b)

ivy: Monitoring hooks: Console dashboard "installer -> canary" + trace ids attached to release notes. I will attach checksums and release notes after publish.

carla: On-call for offsite transfer. If checksum mismatch detected, hold and escalate to security immediately.

ivy: Pushing artifacts now (22:05 UTC). Will update with URIs and cosign digest shortly.

release-bot: push complete 22:10 UTC. Artifacts: sealed://packages/installer-v1.4.7-delta.tar.gz sig: cosign:sha256:abcd1234efgh5678..., manifest: sealed://manifests/epoch-20260320.json

ivy: Posted release notes and checksums: https://internal.releases/redwood/installer/v1.4.7-delta/notes.md

carla: Received. Preparing transport manifest and courier handoff.

ops-bot: Canary metrics: error rate 0.7% (below threshold), median latency +8% (within threshold). No rollback triggered.

ivy: Full rollout scheduled at 23:30 UTC pending final confirm. Thanks all.
